title: 2016 AMC 10B 22
statement: A set of teams held a round-robin tournament in which every team played every other team exactly once. Every team won \(10\) games and lost \(10\) games; there were no ties. How many sets of three teams \(\{A, B, C\}\) were there in which \(A\) beat \(B,\) \(B\) beat \(C,\) and \(C\) beat \(A?\)

solutions.text:
The total number of teams is \(10+10+1=21.\) The total number of sets is therefore \(\binom{21}{3} = 1330.\)

Now, we must subtract the total number of sets such that there is no cycle. This only happens if one team beats the other two teams. There are \(21\) choices for the team that beat the other two and \(\binom{10}{2} = 45\) ways to choose the teams they beat. Thus, the total of non-cycles is \(21\cdot 45=945.\) This means the total number of cycles is \(1330-945=385.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Count all triples of teams, then subtract transitive triples
Each team is the top team in \(\binom{10}{2}\) transitive triples
